rulings.Case Title: CONSERVATORSHIP OF NISSIM LANYADOO
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/7/26. (No earlier availability.) (1) The proof of service filed on 6/16/26 shows the incorrect caption of this amended FIRST account and report. (2) The verification of the amended petition does not verify the correct pleading. (3) The conservator was appointed on 3/7/24, which should be the beginning date of her first accounting and also the date of appointment shown on the face of the I&A. (4) The Partial No. One I&A filed on 6/3/26 shows $6,403.00 in cash, but the I&A starts with $4,310.00 in cash, and the bank statement shows $2,217.00 as of 2/29/24. (5) No Final I&A has been filed. Was the Partial No. One I&A intended to be a Corrected Final I&A? (6) The Partial No. One I&A is not properly verified by the conservator (verification not dated). (7) Item 4 of the Partial No. One I&A was completed, showing the date when the probate referee WAS appointed, not the date on which the court ordered that no probate referee was required. (8) The summary of account does not balance. (9) Is the attorney also waiving fees? No fees may be paid without a Court order. [CRC 7.755(a).] Since the conservatee died on 9/21/25, in order to spare the estate having to pay another filing fee for the second and final accounting, this petition may be fully amended as a second amended first and final accounting, covering the period 3/7/24 - 9/21/25 and also including an accounting for the period subsequent to the date of death. [Probate Code Section 2620(b).] Courtesy copies of the second amended first and final accounting petition and any subsequently filed papers must be received by the assigned examiner by 9/28/26. The summary of account in the body of the petition should not include schedules having "$0" value. [See Probate Code Section 1061(b).] Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10.B. (The Court-appointed attorney has not yet amended her ex parte petition for fees to seek fees at her usual hourly rates.)

rulings.Rulings: Continued to 08/26/2026.
